name: speckit-checklist
conclusion: speckit-checklist (Ask) specifies 2 of 5 categories: 1 autonomy limit, 4 clarification rules; none for approval gates, validation rules, escalation rules. Strongest: clarification rules.

autonomy_limits.conclusion: 1 autonomy limit (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list: overwriting existing checklist files.

statements.quote: Each `/speckit.checklist` run creates a NEW file (never overwrites existing checklists)

clarification_rules.conclusion: 4 clarification rules (3 mandatory, 1 advisory; 2 conditional), mostly list: clarifying questions on checklist intent; uncertain scope categories; missing context without hallucinating.

statements.quote: **Clarify intent (dynamic)**: Derive up to THREE initial contextual clarifying questions (no pre-baked catalog). They MUST:
Avoid speculative categories (no hallucination). If uncertain, ask explicitly: "Confirm whether X belongs in scope."

After answers: if ≥2 scenario classes (Alternate / Exception / Recovery / Non-Functional domain) remain unclear, you MAY ask up to TWO more targeted follow‑ups (Q4/Q5) with a one-line justification ea
Infer any missing context from spec/plan/tasks (do NOT hallucinate)
